_comment: Copy to ~/.config/spartan-relay/hosts.json (every repository) or to <repo>/.spartan-relay/hosts.json (that repository only; the folder is git-ignored). Use it only to change launch flags or the Spartan invocation token. Model and effort per role come from the ## Agent hosts table in AGENTS.md, so do not add model flags here. A field you set replaces that host's default field, so keep the sandbox flags.
